posts.author: transcendnature
posts.body: Would swapping the data folder with a data folder from another project + making sure that other relevant assets are present i.e. like icons and stuff be enough to modify a database for a project, or are there other considerations?

posts.author: Lionbarrel
posts.body:
There is a better way to do it and I use the "RPG Maker MV Tools - Database Converter MV" Which also works for MZ
but just moving a file to another project can cause some problems as everything starts from zero and if you're just moving left to right, there's a good chance that you can override stuff

posts.author: gstv87
posts.body:
technically it should work... but, to what end? the only difference would be the project file itself.
the database *is* the project.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
It will work for copying the entire database into a "new" project, for example if you want to use the same database for a follow-up project or a different story in the same world (or just because you're lazy and don't want to redo your work for your second project).
But it is extremely difficult to make selective copies - as said above that will have a lot of risks in messing up the database.
and in all cases you need to check those common events that interact with maps
